acceptance_criteria.description: Supplemental runner and assertions remain private, bounded, fail closed and within scope.

evidence.command: Seven final private Docker groups: 112 actual supplemental records, all equal, no mismatches/skips; source/binary pinned across groups. Review source, protected expectations, exact effects and user-approved inherited security disposition. All failed captures retained.

Two focused normalization security tests; make migration-check migration-test (32 tests); scoped validation and git diff --check. Final controller processes exited zero with owned cleanup; immutable images and candidate/config/fixture identities retained.

handoff: Finite protected supplemental outcome complete: 112 records pass the same 68a36b9137ce26566b2db91902469e8159885656 candidate, with exact observed responses, storage effects, mixed-runtime switchback, operations, lifecycle and three concrete metadata repairs.
